# Review contracts, lenses, and lifecycle mapping

<!-- Generated by generate_agent_definitions.py; do not edit. -->
<!-- delivery-version: 79abd13a2bda8ad6d83de4001bd283c6b087d6dc 2026-10-26T01:48:39+01:00 -->

Lenses registered by `aiscr-review-pr`.

| Lens | Contract | Focus | Exclusions | Cost | Availability |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| survey | survey | Complete read of the assigned material producing its inventory, receipts, and lens-relevant signals. | Defect adjudication, severity assignment, and proposed fixes. | standard | survey |
| correctness | findings | State, data integrity, concurrency, types, and resource lifetime. | Security exploitation, performance-only costs, and interface/documentation contracts. | standard | default |
| security | findings | Authorization, input trust, injection, secrets, cryptography, and exposure. | Style, unsupported hypothetical exploits, and operational defects with no trust-boundary consequence. | deep | default |
| integration | findings | API, documentation, dependency, build, test, frontend, CI/CD, and operational contracts. | Internal state defects, performance-only costs, security exploitation, and claims of live behavior without probe evidence. | standard | default |
| performance | findings | Queries, repeated work, blocking I/O, memory, startup, and build/runtime resource cost. | Speculative micro-optimizations without a reachable workload or consequential cost. | standard | default |
| duplication | findings | Repeated authored behavior or facts that produce inconsistent fixes and maintenance. | Generated mirrors, deliberate specializations, and similar text with different obligations. | economy | default |
| dead-code | findings | Unreachable first-party behavior, unused configuration, and obsolete integration paths. | Compiler/linter findings, dynamic entry points whose reachability is unresolved, and vendored internals. | economy | default |
| deploy-safety | findings | Migration ordering, rollback, release compatibility, startup sequencing, and recovery. | Security exploitation and generic build failures already owned by integration. | deep | target-enabled |
| verify | verification | Focused verification of candidate findings and prior-finding dispositions. | Fresh broad review and replacement findings outside the assigned candidates. | economy | verification |
